decisions.reason: A door lever handle family sits at the core of the firm's metal-handle engineering and finishing know-how, so it can read early results and refine the family with little new learning.
Mitred lever handles use the firm's existing forming and finishing competence and extend its coordinated product families, so the firm can absorb market feedback and adjust them.
A multifunctional lever draws on the firm's ergonomic and barrier-free expertise, which fits its strategic direction, although the added functions bring slightly more uncertainty.
A single lever handle model is closely related to the firm's established range, and its tooling is cheap to maintain within the firm's own manufacturing.
The FSB 1289 collection has its own page and won the 2023 German Design Award, giving clear positive feedback on a product that builds directly on core competences.
A light patinated bronze finish uses the firm's own finishing and high-grade metals expertise, adds variety across its product families at low cost, and supports architect-driven specification.
